address: 216/19 Mu 3, Soi Hua Tha 1, Si Sunthon, Thalang, Phuket, 83110, Thailand
bio: Krua Praya showcases Southern Thai, especially Phuket, cuisine. Its traditional décor and captivating rooftop charm visitors. The menu features skilfully prepared dishes with bold flavours and enticing aromas. The standout pork belly dishes include the signature fried pork belly with curry paste and young coconut shoots, delivering a crispy, spicy delight. Alternatively, the Phuket-style stew offers a rich non-spicy option, served in a satisfying gravy....
